description: This file implements a feature flag synchronization mechanism for Mattermost, utilizing the Split.io client to fetch and update feature flags based on external treatments, with support for concurrency and error handling.

classes.name: SyncParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for synchronizing feature flags, including server ID, split key, interval, logger, and attributes.

classes.name: Synchronizer
classes.description: Manages feature flag synchronization using the Split.io client, including initialization, readiness check, updating flags, and cleanup.

methods.name: NewSynchronizer
methods.description: Creates a new Synchronizer instance with provided parameters, initializing the Split.io client.

methods.name: EnsureReady
methods.description: Blocks until the Split.io client is ready to provide feature flag treatments.

methods.name: UpdateFeatureFlagValues
methods.description: Fetches feature flag treatments from Split.io and updates the feature flags accordingly.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Destroys the Split.io client and cleans up resources.
